customCommands.name: java-test
customCommands.description: Generate JUnit test for Java method
customCommands.prompt:
Generate a comprehensive JUnit 5 test for the selected Java method. Include:
- @Test, @BeforeEach, @AfterEach annotations
- Edge cases and boundary conditions
- Null checks and exception handling with assertThrows
- Mock objects using Mockito if needed
- Clear test method names following shouldXxxWhenYyy pattern
- Proper assertions with messages
- @DisplayName annotations for better readability

{{{ input }}}

customCommands.name: test-rag
customCommands.prompt:
Extract method name and class from:
{{{ input }}}

Then execute:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/generate/test -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"target_method": "METHOD", "class_name": "CLASS"}' | jq '.test_code'

customCommands.name: explain-java
customCommands.description: Explain Java code structure and dependencies
customCommands.prompt:
Analyze and explain the selected Java code:
- What it does and its purpose
- Input parameters and their purpose
- Return value and type
- Dependencies on other classes/methods
- Possible edge cases and error conditions
- Complexity analysis (time/space)
- Testing recommendations
- Potential improvements

{{{ input }}}

customCommands.name: refactor-java
customCommands.description: Suggest refactoring improvements for Java code
customCommands.prompt:
Analyze the selected Java code and suggest refactoring improvements:
- Code smell detection
- Performance optimizations
- Readability improvements
- SOLID principles compliance
- Design pattern suggestions
- Method extraction opportunities
- Variable naming improvements
- Documentation suggestions

{{{ input }}}

customCommands.name: debug-java
customCommands.prompt:
Help debug the selected Java code:
- Identify potential bugs
- Suggest debugging strategies
- Recommend logging improvements
- Error handling analysis
- Performance bottleneck detection
- Memory leak prevention
- Thread safety considerations
- Best practices for debugging

{{{ input }}}
